publicationPolicy.scope: Eleven retained English and Spanish municipality market-research routes in Union and Morris counties
publicationPolicy.municipalityDataRule: Publish only the exact finalized 2025 municipality row and field labels from the New Jersey Division of Taxation table.
publicationPolicy.averageRule: Avg Assessment, Avg Tax Bill, and Avg Sales Price are averages, never medians.
publicationPolicy.currentMarketRule: Changing 2026 conditions remain at the linked New Jersey Realtors county portal; county results are not represented as municipality results.
publicationPolicy.propertyRule: A municipality average or county report is not a property valuation. A CMA requires current comparable properties and property details.
publicationPolicy.publicationHandling: Link to the public New Jersey Realtors county portal without copying its tables; do not scrape or reproduce member-only municipality reports.
publicationPolicy.corrections: Source-link, source-row, field-label, period, or geography corrections may be sent through the site contact page.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sources.title: Property Tax Statistics
sources.geographyType: state directory with county and taxing-district tables
sources.use: Locate the Division of Taxation's published residential-statistics table and related definitions.
sources.limit: Assessment and tax statistics are not listing-service statistics or a valuation of a particular property.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sources.title: 2025 Average Residential Statistics
sources.use: Publish the reviewed row using the table's exact field labels: # of Line Items, Avg Assessment, Avg Tax Bill, # of Sales, and Avg Sales Price.
sources.limit: The table publishes averages, not medians. Its 2025 district row is not a 2026 MLS report and not a current property CMA.

sources.title: 10K Market Data
sources.use: Confirm the public route to state and county reports and the member-only boundary for municipality reports.
sources.limit: This site does not copy, scrape, or imply access to member-only municipality reports.

sources.title: Public State and County Reports
sources.use: Let readers review changing county conditions at the source after selecting the county, period, and available property category.
sources.limit: A county result does not describe a municipality or a particular property; tables are viewed at the source and are not reproduced here.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs
sources.title: Construction Reporter
sources.reportingPeriod: permit and certificate reporting periods selected at the source
sources.use: Research construction-permit and certificate activity reported by local officials.
sources.limit: Permit and certificate activity is not current for-sale inventory and does not predict a future sale.

sources.title: American Community Survey Data Profiles
sources.geographyType: survey geography selected by the user
sources.use: Use Selected Housing Characteristics profile DP04 for longer-horizon municipality housing context.
sources.limit: ACS values are survey estimates for the named release, not current transactions, listings, appraisals, or a market forecast.
